name: Player Status Surface + Nord Complete Pilot

survey.name: Survey Devotion
survey.description: Ask PlayerDevotion for a thematic readout of your current standing.

messages.title: Hircine's Pull
messages.body: The beast is in the Companions' gift, but it stands against Shor's hall. Your seat on the bridge weakens while the hunt holds.

messages.title: Sovngarde Closes
messages.body: Molag Bal's shadow has fallen across you. Sovngarde will not name you while you carry his thirst. Cure the curse, and even then the scar remains.

messages.title: The Door Stands Ajar
messages.body: The thirst is gone. The bridge is open again. But Tsun has seen what walked into the dark, and that is not forgotten.

contracts.speaker: Froki
contracts.prompt: I sleep where Kyne sleeps. I hunt where she hunts.
contracts.response: Then you know her by more than shrine-talk. Keep to the sky, hunter.

contracts.speaker: Heimskr
contracts.prompt: The old breath is mine to carry. Tell me what is needed.
contracts.response: Then shout it where they can hear. Talos lives in every brave breath.

contracts.speaker: Andurs
contracts.prompt: I keep the rites. What is owed the dead here?
contracts.response: Then help me keep them. Arkay asks little, but the dead are owed much.

contracts.speaker: Aela
contracts.prompt: The hunt pulls at Sovngarde. What do you see in me?
contracts.response: I see a hunter, not a feast-hall saint. Carry the beast, or master it.
conditions: curse state Werewolf or active Hircine path

closeoutRules: Run from a fresh Nord save or a main-menu coc qasmoke path; do not count stale script instances.
Use the Player page and Survey Devotion as the player-facing proof surface.
Use Developer Options only to set up or inspect proof state; numeric piety remains dev-only.
After CK dialogue authoring, refresh PlayerDevotion_Framework.seq before closeout.
Every positive dialogue case needs at least one matching negative: wrong race, wrong deity/state, wrong tier, or vampire-blocked as applicable.

systemCases.setup: Fresh Nord start with PlayerDevotion initialized.
systemCases.positive: MCM opens on Player, shows thematic summary/mode/patron/standing/curse/favor/neglect rows, and offers Survey Devotion.
systemCases.negative: Player page does not show exact numeric piety.

systemCases.setup: Enable Developer Options on Player page, save, reload.
systemCases.positive: Status and Debug pages unlock and remain unlocked after reload.
systemCases.negative: With Developer Options disabled, Status and Debug show locked text only.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin, patron state Broad, Nord baseline OldWays.
systemCases.positive: Survey Devotion describes broad Old Ways standing and does not name a focused patron.
systemCases.negative: Focused-only commitment text does not appear.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin, patron state Broad, Nord baseline NineDivines.
systemCases.positive: Survey Devotion describes broad Nine Divines standing and does not name a focused patron.
systemCases.negative: Old Ways-specific wording does not appear.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin, active Kyne, tier Champion or higher.
systemCases.positive: Survey Devotion names the Kyne bond and the Player page reports focused standing.
systemCases.negative: Talos recognition/status wording does not appear.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin, active Talos, tier Champion or higher.
systemCases.positive: Survey Devotion names the Talos bond and the Player page reports focused standing.
systemCases.negative: Kyne recognition/status wording does not appear.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin with curse state Werewolf or active Hircine path.
systemCases.positive: Werewolf/Hircine tension is visible through Survey Devotion, Player page curse status, and Aela dialogue eligibility.
systemCases.negative: The system does not treat Hircine as a normal Nord god in PDV_FLST_AllDeities.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin with curse state Vampire.
systemCases.positive: Survey Devotion reports Sovngarde closed; Nord commitment offers and contextual favors are suppressed.
systemCases.negative: No Molag Bal devotional lane starts and patron piety is not cleared.

systemCases.setup: Nord origin transitions from Vampire back to None.
systemCases.positive: Commitment and favor access return, and Survey/Player status preserves a vampire scar note.
systemCases.negative: The scar does not erase existing patron piety or rewrite the active patron.

systemCases.setup: Save and reload after Survey power grant, Developer Options change, active favor, vampire scar, and selected Nord posture.
systemCases.positive: Survey power, UI gate state, active/expired favor behavior, vampire scar, and posture summaries remain consistent.
systemCases.negative: No duplicate Survey power or stale active favor is created by reload.

dialogueCases.positive: Froki offers the Kyne Champion recognition only for Nord origin, active Kyne, tier >= Champion.
Heimskr offers the Talos Champion recognition only for Nord origin, active Talos, tier >= Champion.
Andurs offers the broad death-rite recognition only for Nord origin, broad patron state, and non-vampire curse state.
Aela offers the hunt/Sovngarde tension recognition only for Nord origin with Werewolf curse state or active Hircine path.
negatives: curse state None with no active Hircine path
curse state Vampire with no active Hircine path
